output.summary: KEP-4368 adds a "managedBy" field to the Job spec so an external controller (for example Kueue in MultiKueue) can take over Job synchronization instead of the built-in Job controller. The KEP is implemented and stable.
output.rationale: MultiKueue runs a mirror Job in a worker cluster while the user's Job lives in the management cluster, so the status must be synchronized by Kueue rather than the main Job controller. The design therefore needs a way to disable the main Job controller for a given Job and delegate sync to an external controller. The "managedBy" field is the lightweight mechanism chosen for this.

alternatives.option: Passing custom parameters to the external controller
alternatives.why_not: Listed as a non-goal in the readme, so it was explicitly excluded from the design.

evidence.quote: We support the "managedBy" field as a lightweight mechanism to delegate the Job synchronization to an external controller.
In order to support this workflow we need a mechanism to disable the main Job controller, and delegate the status synchronization to the Kueue controller.
The proposal is to support the "managedBy" field in the Job spec to indicate the only controller responsible for the Job object synchronization.
